summary: Defined packageable Alpha defaults for policy pack, semantic tool manifest, and ModelBroker config. The defaults preserve exact approval binding, deny normal-mode shell execution, expose only typed semantic tools, and keep ModelBroker in stub/local-only mode without network or external credentials.

acceptance_evidence.policy_defaults: policy-pack.json preserves read-only allow, high-risk pause, never deny, exact approval token binding, broad approval denial, and denied-no-effect semantics.
acceptance_evidence.semantic_tool_manifest: semantic-tools.json lists svc.logs, svc.status, http.check, config.test, fs.read, fs.write.diff, svc.restart, audit.show, and rollback.trigger; shell.exec is absent.
acceptance_evidence.model_broker_defaults: model-broker.toml defaults to stub/local-only mode, requires no network or credentials for stub-local, and marks remote provider disabled and optional.
acceptance_evidence.secret_safety: Config defaults contain policy labels and metadata only, not raw secrets, tokens, or provider credentials.
acceptance_evidence.rootfs_mapping: Config paths mirror /etc/agentos policy, tools, and model broker targets for later rootfs staging.

verification.json_parse: policy-pack.json and semantic-tools.json parse with ConvertFrom-Json.
verification.shell_denial: shell.exec is absent from semantic-tools.json and appears only as an explicit deny entry in policy-pack.json.
verification.runtime_tests: No Rust runtime code changed for this packaging task; existing safety gates remain the required downstream gate.
